points.label: Jesus’ response
points.left: People ask why John’s disciples and the Pharisees’ disciples fast while Jesus’ disciples do not, and Jesus answers with bridegroom, cloth, and wineskin images.
points.right: After Jesus prays, a disciple asks him to teach them to pray as John also taught his disciples, and Jesus gives them words of prayer.
